resources.string: To launch your assistant from the home screen or lock screen, allow the permissions below in Other permissions. Tap a row to open settings. These permissions cannot be granted with a normal permission popup.

Some systems restrict launching the assistant while LibrePods is in the background. Allow display over other apps and check background restrictions if launching fails. Your assistant may require separate lock screen settings.
Open windows while running in the background
Allows an earbud press to open the assistant after you leave LibrePods.
Allows launching the assistant while locked. This does not unlock your phone.
Some systems require this permission to launch the assistant from the background.
Open LibrePods app info in system settings and check Other permissions.
